old: UK goods carry a flat 10 percent (USTR notice of action, 23 July 2026). Yachts over 24 metres carry an MFN duty of 1.5 percent (US tariff headings 8903.23 for sail and 8903.33 for motor), so a yacht built in the EU now pays 10 percent in all.
new: UK goods carry an additional 10 percent on top of the MFN duty (USTR notice of action, 23 July 2026). Yachts over 24 metres carry an MFN duty of 1.5 percent (US tariff headings 8903.23 for sail and 8903.33 for motor), so a yacht built in the EU now pays 10 percent in all and one built in the UK 11.5 percent, subject to classification and any product exemption.
